<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1108
Claimant:
Kimberly Gentry
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
22 Nov 2023
The insured reported a left-turn collision at an intersection and said the other vehicle struck the passenger side of her
car as it crossed the oncoming lane. She is reporting neck and back strain and has retained counsel, so all contact
will go through the attorney's office.
29 Nov 2023
The driver is named on the policy and the vehicle is listed as a covered unit. Nothing in our records suggests the
damage occurred before coverage began.
22 Dec 2023
Photos taken at the scene show damage that lines up with the described impact on the passenger side and front
quarter panel. The estimate has been sent to the appraiser for review.
7 Feb 2024
Police and two drivers at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. No independent witnesses
have come forward to describe how the collision happened.
18 Mar 2024
The claimant's account of the crash has stayed consistent across the recorded statement, the follow-up call, and the
written summary from counsel. The details of the turn and the point of impact match each time.
29 Apr 2024
Medical records show a neck and back strain, which is a plausible injury for a side impact of this type. No earlier injury
to the same body area appears in the claim history or prior records we obtained.
14 May 2024
Treatment began within a few days of the collision and followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication.
Visits tapered off as her range of motion improved and her pain eased.
8 Jun 2024
The appraiser reviewed the vehicle and found no earlier damage to the same panels. The repair scope fits the impact
pattern described in the statement and the scene photos.
12 Jun 2024
Counsel has asked for a settlement of the bodily injury portion of the claim. The request is being reviewed against the
treatment records and the billing summary.
20 Jun 2024
The bills received so far are itemized and match the treatment dates in the medical file. The adjuster will complete the
evaluation of the injury claim once the final records arrive.
21 Jun 2024
File reviewed and current status recorded. Property damage is ready for payment on the repair estimate, and the
bodily injury evaluation remains open pending the final medical summary.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
